facts.note: It was not until 1863 that French mineralogist Alexis Damour determined that what was referred to as "jade" could in fact be one of two different minerals, either nephrite or jadeite.

facts.claim: 영어 jade 는 스페인어 piedra de ijada 옆구리 돌 — 허리·콩팥 병
facts.note: The English word jade is derived ... from the Spanish term piedra de ijada (first recorded in 1565) or 'flank stone', from its reputed efficacy in curing ailments of the loins and kidneys.
Of the two, jadeite is rarer, documented in fewer than 12 places worldwide.
Today, it is estimated that Myanmar is the origin of upwards of 70% of the world's supply of high-quality jadeite.

question.hintNote: The discovery in 1968 of two complete jade suits in the tombs of Liu Sheng and Dou Wan in Mancheng, Hebei ... consisted of 2,498 plates of solid jade connected with two and a half pounds of gold wires.
